name: When should I repair a door lock versus replacing it entirely?

mainEntity.name: When should I repair a door lock versus replacing it entirely?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between repairing and replacing a door lock depends on the extent of the damage and the type of lock. Minor issues like a loose handle, a sticky mechanism that needs lubrication, or a worn-out strike plate can often be repaired cost-effectively. However, if the lock has been significantly damaged by a break-in, is severely rusted, or if critical internal components are broken or obsolete, replacement is generally recommended for better security and reliability. An assessment by a qualified technician can help determine the best course of action.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair minor issues like loose handles or sticky mechanisms. Replace locks with significant damage from break-ins, severe rust, or broken internal components.
